executive_summary: Resolves the YouTube 'For Processing' playlist's credential architecture, gated on a single pending chairman decision (can the playlist be made Unlisted?). LEAD-phase diligence found the original carve-out plan understated the real engineering work on both branches: the credential-free option needs a captured playlist ID and a playlistItem-id-preserving API-key read (not plain RSS, which would strand rows), while the OAuth-fallback option needs a separate read-only client rather than narrowing the existing shared scope (which 6 production call sites in the disposal path depend on for writes). This PRD documents both corrected branches and gates all implementation code behind the still-open chairman decision.

functional_requirements.title: Chairman decision gate (blocking, not code)
functional_requirements.description: Before any code in FR-2 through FR-6 is touched, chairman_decisions row id a94f88c8-bf97-4c04-a11a-084817cdc185 ("Can the 'For Processing' YouTube playlist be switched from Private to Unlisted?") must have status != 'pending'. Check it live at the start of EXEC -- do not assume the answer from context, since this SD may resume in a different session/day.
acceptance_criteria: EXEC phase begins by querying chairman_decisions for id a94f88c8 and branches on the answer.
If still pending, EXEC halts and re-signals rather than guessing or defaulting to a branch.

functional_requirements.title: Capture the target playlist ID (both branches need this)
functional_requirements.description: playlist-sync.js currently discovers the "For Processing" playlist by NAME via an OAuth playlists.list({mine:true}) call. Neither branch removes this discovery step for free -- the playlist's actual ID must be captured once (via the existing OAuth-authenticated discovery, run one time, or read from the YouTube Studio URL) and stored as config (e.g. YOUTUBE_FOR_PROCESSING_PLAYLIST_ID env var), before either branch's steady-state sync can run without OAuth.
acceptance_criteria: A playlist ID is captured and stored as a named env var, not hardcoded inline.
The one-time OAuth discovery call used to capture it is documented (script or manual step), not left as an unexplained magic string.

functional_requirements.title: PREFERRED branch: credential-free playlist read via YOUTUBE_API_KEY (if Unlisted)
functional_requirements.description: If the chairman answers YES (Unlisted is acceptable): re-point playlist-sync.js to use youtube.playlistItems.list with a plain YOUTUBE_API_KEY (matching the existing production precedent in lib/integrations/youtube/video-metadata.js, NOT the RSS pattern). CORRECTED from the original plan: plain RSS (feeds/videos.xml?playlist_id=<id>) was live-probed and confirmed to return items, but it lacks a playlistItem id -- a field populated on 284/284 current rows and consumed by 3 modules (playlist-sync.js itself, post-processor.js, strategy-extract-core.js) for playlistItems.delete-based disposal. Using RSS would strand every new row post-ingestion. playlistItems.list preserves playlistItem id and is the corrected implementation. Remove the oauth-manager.js import from playlist-sync.js entirely once this ships.
acceptance_criteria: playlist-sync.js no longer imports getAuthenticatedClient from oauth-manager.js.
Fetched items carry a real playlistItem id usable by the existing disposal path.
A workflow_dispatch run of eva-idea-sync-cron.yml shows a real item count in the YouTube step's log, not just a green exit code.

functional_requirements.title: FALLBACK branch: two-client OAuth design with narrowed read scope (if playlist stays Private)
functional_requirements.description: If the chairman answers NO: CORRECTED from the original plan -- oauth-manager.js's SCOPES constant is a SINGLE SHARED CONSTANT also exercised read+write by 6 production call sites in post-processor.js (lines 183, 262, 277) and strategy-extract-core.js (lines 271, 302, 329) for the disposal/post-processing path. Narrowing SCOPES to youtube.readonly as the original plan described would break disposal for every existing consumer. The corrected design: introduce a SECOND, read-only OAuth client (its own scope constant, its own token storage key distinct from the existing shared one) used ONLY by playlist-sync.js's read path, while the existing full-scope client remains untouched for post-processor.js/strategy-extract-core.js's disposal writes. Publish the Google OAuth consent screen to Production, re-consent for the new read-only client with scope youtube.readonly, store its refresh_token + GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET as named, GitHub-Environment-scoped secrets (not bare repo secrets -- this repo is public with 210+ workflows).
acceptance_criteria: A new, distinct read-only OAuth client/scope constant exists, separate from the existing shared read+write client.
post-processor.js and strategy-extract-core.js are unmodified and continue to use the existing (unchanged) client.
The new client's credentials are provisioned via a GitHub Environment, not a bare repository secret.
oauth-manager.js's DB read/write of the NEW client's tokens is via env var only, no DB fallback (matching the FR-3-closed exposure class from the parent SD).

functional_requirements.title: Verify a real pull, not a green exit code
functional_requirements.description: Whichever branch ships, run a workflow_dispatch of eva-idea-sync-cron.yml and query eva_youtube_intake row counts before/after -- a green exit code alone is not evidence (the sibling youtube-subscription-digest.yml workflow already demonstrates a job can report success while holding a nonexistent credential).
acceptance_criteria: eva_youtube_intake row count increases by the number of new videos in the playlist since last sync.
The YouTube step's log output shows an item count, not just exit code 0.

functional_requirements.title: Pre-existing circuit breaker reset (blocking prerequisite, independent of this SD's decision)
functional_requirements.description: VALIDATION sub-agent found the sync's circuit breaker is already latched open (consecutive_failures=3) and syncYouTube() early-returns skipped:true before any state update -- it cannot self-heal. This must be manually reset before FR-5's verification can run, regardless of which branch ships. This is a pre-existing condition, not something either branch introduces.
acceptance_criteria: The circuit breaker's failure count for the youtube source is reset before the FR-5 verification run.
The reset is logged (who/when/why) so it's auditable, not a silent DB edit.

technical_requirements.title: No implementation code until FR-1's gate clears
technical_requirements.description: This SD's own plan states 'do not start either branch until the chairman answers.' PLAN phase (this PRD) documents both branches accurately; EXEC phase must not write FR-3/FR-4 code until FR-1 confirms an answer.

technical_requirements.title: Old refresh token revocation is a separate, already-escalated action
technical_requirements.description: A previously-flagged live plaintext refresh_token for this exact playlist was already confirmed dead (revoke->invalid_token, refresh-grant->invalid_grant) and purged by SD-FDBK-ENH-SECURITY-CRITICAL-SAFETY-001 -- this SD does not need to repeat that action, only confirm (do not assume) it stays revoked if FR-4 ships a new token.

test_scenarios.scenario: FR-1 gate blocks EXEC when decision is still pending
test_scenarios.expected: A pre-EXEC check against chairman_decisions id a94f88c8 halts progress with a clear message rather than defaulting to a branch.

test_scenarios.scenario: FR-3 (if shipped): playlistItems.list preserves playlistItem id end to end
test_scenarios.expected: A synced row in eva_youtube_intake carries a non-null playlistItem id usable by the existing disposal path.

test_scenarios.scenario: FR-4 (if shipped): post-processor.js and strategy-extract-core.js still function after the new read-only client is introduced
test_scenarios.expected: Existing disposal-path tests for post-processor.js/strategy-extract-core.js pass unchanged, proving the shared full-scope client was not touched.
eva_youtube_intake row count increases after a workflow_dispatch run, matching the number of new videos actually in the playlist.

acceptance_criteria: Chairman decision a94f88c8 answered and the corresponding branch (FR-3 or FR-4) implemented accordingly.
eva-idea-sync-cron.yml's YouTube step demonstrates a real, verified pull (FR-5), not a false-green.
No regression to post-processor.js/strategy-extract-core.js's disposal path regardless of which branch ships.

risks.risk: Chairman may not answer promptly, leaving this SD queued indefinitely.
risks.mitigation: SD sits as a normal, workable DRAFT/PLANNING-status item, not hard-blocked at the protocol level; EXEC's FR-1 gate re-checks the live decision status rather than assuming staleness.

risks.risk: Naively narrowing oauth-manager.js's shared SCOPES constant (as the original plan described) would silently break post-processor.js/strategy-extract-core.js's disposal path.
risks.mitigation: FR-4's corrected two-client design keeps the existing shared client untouched; TS-3 regression-tests the disposal path explicitly.

risks.risk: Plain RSS (the original plan's lead credential-free option) would strand new rows by omitting playlistItem id.
risks.mitigation: FR-3 corrected to use YOUTUBE_API_KEY playlistItems.list instead, which preserves playlistItem id; TS-2 verifies this explicitly.

risks.risk: FR-5's verification is itself blocked by a pre-existing, unrelated circuit-breaker latch.
risks.mitigation: FR-6 requires a manual reset before verification, tracked as its own acceptance criterion so it isn't silently skipped.

dependencies: existing oauth-manager.js shared client (FR-4 path, must remain unmodified)
data_contracts: eva_youtube_intake (playlistItem id column, consumed by disposal path)
runtime_config: YOUTUBE_API_KEY (FR-3 path) or new read-only OAuth client secrets (FR-4 path, GitHub-Environment-scoped)
observability_rollout: FR-5's before/after row-count check on eva_youtube_intake via a workflow_dispatch run

system_architecture.summary: Two mutually exclusive credential architectures for the YouTube 'For Processing' playlist read, gated on one external chairman decision; the existing OAuth-based disposal path (post-processor.js/strategy-extract-core.js) is unaffected by either branch.

components.name: lib/integrations/youtube/playlist-sync.js
components.change: FR-3: drop OAuth dependency, add YOUTUBE_API_KEY playlistItems.list. FR-4: swap to a new read-only OAuth client instead of the shared one.

components.name: lib/integrations/youtube/oauth-manager.js
components.change: FR-4 only: add a second, read-only client/scope constant + its own token storage key, alongside the existing unchanged shared client.

components.name: .github/workflows/eva-idea-sync-cron.yml
components.change: FR-4 only: add environment: + new secret env vars, GitHub-Environment-scoped.

implementation_approach.summary: Resolve the chairman decision, capture the playlist ID once, then implement the answered branch without touching the existing disposal-path OAuth client.
steps: 1. Re-check chairman_decisions id a94f88c8 for an answer (FR-1).
2. Capture and store the target playlist ID as config (FR-2), using a one-time OAuth-authenticated discovery call.
3a. If YES: implement FR-3 (YOUTUBE_API_KEY playlistItems.list), remove OAuth import from playlist-sync.js.
3b. If NO: implement FR-4 (new read-only OAuth client, GitHub-Environment-scoped secrets), leaving the existing shared client untouched.
4. Reset the pre-existing circuit breaker latch (FR-6).
5. Run FR-5's workflow_dispatch verification with before/after row counts.

smoke_test_steps.instruction: Query chairman_decisions for id a94f88c8-bf97-4c04-a11a-084817cdc185 and read its status column.
smoke_test_steps.expected_outcome: status is either 'pending' (decision still open, this SD stays deferred) or answered with a recorded decision.

smoke_test_steps.instruction: Once answered YES (Unlisted): trigger a workflow_dispatch run of eva-idea-sync-cron.yml and check the YouTube step's log output for an item count.
smoke_test_steps.expected_outcome: The log shows a real playlist pull (N items fetched via YOUTUBE_API_KEY), zero OAuth references in the call path.

smoke_test_steps.instruction: Query eva_youtube_intake row count before and after the same workflow_dispatch run.
smoke_test_steps.expected_outcome: Row count increases by the number of new videos in the playlist since last sync.
